# DSH Sticky Notes · 便签墙
A sticky-note wall for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web and Desktop: a sidebar entry, a masonry wall of no
tes, pasted images and text, due reminders, done state, keyboard shortcuts, a pin-on-top floating wi
ndow, appearance skins, and an optional **native always-on-top Windows desktop window**.
中文说明
## Features
- **Sidebar entry** — a sticky-note icon in the left rail with an overdue badge; it opens the wall i

n the main column.
- **Pinned notes** — pin any note with the pushpin or the editor toggle. Pinned n
otes appear in a **floating window that floats above every Harness panel** and survives panel switch

es. Drag the title bar to move it (positions snap to the screen edges), collapse it, or hide it.
- *
*Floating quick capture** — the floating window has its own capture box: type, `Ctrl/Cmd+Enter`, and
the new note is pinned immediately. Pinned cards support inline editing, done toggles, due chips an

d image thumbnails.
- **Desktop window (Windows)** — open a **native always-on-top window** that ren
ders the pinned notes outside Harness, above other applications. The helper is compiled from the shi
pped C# source on first use (about ten seconds) and runs on the Microsoft Edge WebView2 runtime that
Windows 10/11 already ships.
- **Images and text** — paste screenshots with `Ctrl/Cmd+V`, drop files, or pick images in the wall,
the editor and the floating window. Images are stored under the plugin data directory and reference

d by file name.
- **Due reminders** — set a due time per note; overdue notes raise an in-app reminde
r with *View / Done / Snooze 10 min*, an optional desktop notification, a sidebar badge, and a "Due

today" filter.
- **Done state** — tick a note to complete it; completed notes fade, gain a line-thro

ugh and move to the Done filter.
- **Appearance** — pick the note colour scheme (follow theme / ligh
t paper / dark paper), paper surface (auto / solid / frosted glass), contrast, default colour, font
family, text size, line height, corner radius and density. Notes choose their own paper colour, so t

hey stay readable on light themes, dark themes and wallpaper backgrounds alike.
- **Manual order** —

switch the wall to *Manual* and drag cards to reorder them; the order is persisted per note.
- **Lo
gin start** — optionally register Harness in `HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run` so

the notes are available right after sign-in.
- **Keyboard shortcuts**
| Shortcut | Action |

| `Ctrl/Cmd + Shift + N` | Open the wall and start a new note from anywhere |
| `Ctrl/Cmd + Shift +

P` | Show or hide the floating window |
| `N` | New note inside the wall |
| `Ctrl/Cmd + Enter` | Sa

ve (editor, quick capture, inline float edit) |
| `/` | Focus search |
| `?` | Shortcut sheet |
| `E
sc` | Close the editor, cancel an inline edit, or close the image preview |

After updating the host half (`index.js`), restart Harness once so the new JavaScript generation loa
ds; the browser half reloads through the client bundle watcher.
## Settings
`Settings → Sticky Notes` collects every appearance and desktop option:
- **Appearance** — colours, paper surface, contrast, default colour, font, text size, line height, r

adius, density, live preview.
- **Floating window** — width, opacity, position lock, open on start,

show/hide.
- **Desktop & order** — native desktop window, login start, note ordering.
## Desktop window details
- Windows only. Requires the .NET Framework compiler (`csc.exe`, included in Windows 10/11) and the

WebView2 runtime.
- Compiled on first use into the plugin data directory; the package ships source o

nly.
- The window is draggable by its title bar, collapsible by double-clicking it, resizable from t

he bottom-right grip, and remembers its bounds.
- Clicking any note focuses the Harness window; the
tray icon offers *Show / Reload / Quit*; the window closes itself when Harness exits.
